title: 基于图结构的语音识别错误校正框架
summary: 提出G-SPIN框架，结合图神经网络构建语音候选集，利用掩码语言模型评分和大语言模型重排序，在推理时轻量级校正ASR错误，解耦语音推理与语义选择。
summary_en: Proposes G-SPIN, a framework combining graph neural networks for phonetic candidate construction, masked language model scoring, and LLM re-ranking to correct ASR errors at inference time, decoupling phonetic reasoning from semantic selection.
